Name: Bigger coop barn and silo from Ghilland
Author: Ghilminion
Description:
The farmer once asked Robin:

"-Hey, Robin, could you make bigger barn and coop?I want to save some place on my farm.
-Yes...but you know...with great power comes great responsibility...i mean, with bigger building comes higher price.
-I though that, but that will be okay...and what about the construction time?
-Hmm...toss a coin to your carpenter...if you add a little more extra gold, i will reduce my 12 hour lunch break and the
construction time will remain 3 days.
-Okay, i think this is reasonable...and what about the silo? You know, with more place to animals, we need more place in the
silo.
-Piece of hay...just you know...
-I know, i know...here is the extra gold"



Building changes
Silo:
800 gold, 400 stone, 40 clay, 20 copper bar -you can store 900 hay now in 1 silo
Coop:
9000 gold, 600 wood, 200 stone - place for 8animals
Big coop:
22000 gold, 800 wood, 300 stone - placefor 16 animals
Deluxe coop:
47000 gold, 999 wood, 400 stone - placefor 24 animals
Barn:
13000 gold, 700 wood, 300 stone - placefor 8 animals
Big barn:
25000 gold, 900 wood, 400 stone - placefor 16 animals
Deluxe barn:
59000 gold, 999 wood, 600 stone - placefor 24 animals

Known bug: if you upgrade you barn to big barn, or your big barn to deluxe barn while your feeding bench is full, one hay will appear somewhere in the barn which cant be picked up or removed. I´m working on a solution, but until i find it, please, before you upgrade your barn/big barn, make sure the feeding bench is empty.

How to install:
1 - Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]2 - Download and extract [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] into your Stardew Valley/mods folder
3 - Extract ﻿"Bigger coop barn and silo from Ghilland" into your Stardew Valley/mods folder
4 - Run the game with SMAPI
5 - Enjoy ;)
